purpose: Define controlled removal of a compute node from workload placement, migration/drain of services and final retirement while preserving inventory/history.

topics.name: Node Drain and Retirement
topics.purpose: Define controlled removal of a compute node from workload placement, migration/drain of services and final retirement while preserving inventory/history.

semantics.admission_rule: New workload placement is blocked during drain.
semantics.service_rule: Running services are explicitly migrated/stopped according to policy.
semantics.secret_rule: Node-local credentials/secrets are revoked/removed according to policy.
semantics.retire_rule: Retired node remains historical identity evidence.
semantics.authority_rule: Node retirement does not delete domain data by implication.

invariants.rule: Release candidate, accepted release, deployment plan, deployment execution, installed artifact, active runtime instance and observed health remain separate identities/states.
Operational convenience, availability pressure, maintenance state, automation, recovery or rollback never silently bypass validation, authorization, integrity, governance or dispatcher boundaries.

hard_gates.condition: node disappears from inventory when powered off
same hostname reused as old identity
